lines.zh: 低吼向前，水面波纹荡漾。
lines.en: Rumble forward, ripples disturb the water.
Slither on the surface, swaying tail fin.
Climb out of the water, water splashes.
Swallow quickly, digest prey.
Patrol the shore, watchful.
Stretches neck, spies in the water.
Slides on the surface, feet alternating.
Lightly leaps, swiftly approaching.
Submerges quietly, waits for prey.
Ambush on the shore, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 半身浸在水里，只露背脊。
lines.en: Half submerged, only its back shows.
Four feet press through river mud.
Lazily swims on the surface.
Slowly swims, enjoying peace.
Sunbath on the shore, wait for prey.
Lays down on the shore, rests.
Floats on the surface, enjoys coolness.
Rests on the shore, waits for an opportunity.
Gently swims, leisurely.
Sunbath, patiently waits.
Swims slowly, thinks.
Rests on the shore, regulates breath.
Only its nostrils break the surface.
Its tail draws slow circles underwater.
It lies still against the stone bank.

lines.zh: 喉头起伏，等着呼吸换气。
lines.en: Its throat rises, saving up a breath.
Raises head, locks target.
Sharp eyes, observing the player.
Eyes glint, staring at the player.
Below the surface, only my eyes show.
Fixes on the player, ready to strike.
The bank is too quiet; you should leave.
Focused eyes, locking on the player.
Locks on prey, ready to hunt.
Fixes on the player, waits for action.
Two eyes surface before the rest.

lines.zh: 它把你的倒影看成了鱼。
lines.en: It takes your reflection for a fish.
Mud drips from its snout.

lines.zh: 鳞片破裂，痛得我喘不过气！
lines.en: Scales broken, it hurts to breathe!

lines.zh: 我感觉筋疲力尽，快要倒下了。
lines.en: I feel so tired, almost collapsing.

lines.zh: 身体受损，行动越来越迟缓。
lines.en: Injured, my movements are slower.

lines.zh: 伤口剧痛，每一步都艰难。
lines.en: Wounds painful, every step hard.

lines.zh: 虚弱难耐，我几乎站立不住。
lines.en: Too weak, nearly falling over.
Pain unbearable, gasping for breath.

lines.zh: 伤口流血，疼痛让我颤抖。
lines.en: Wounds bleeding, pain makes me tremble.

lines.zh: 受伤太重，我无法再战斗。
lines.en: Too badly hurt, can't fight anymore.

lines.zh: 筋疲力尽，我几乎要窒息了。
lines.en: Too exhausted, almost suffocating.

lines.zh: 伤势严重，我支撑不住了。
lines.en: Severely injured, can't hold on.
Water ripples; it creeps near.
Sensory appendages feel your presence.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁。
lines.en: Its eyes glow in the dark.
Claws grip, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 沼泽泥浆中潜伏着危险。
lines.en: Danger lurks in the swamp mud.
Your bait attracts prey.
It surfaces, ready to attack.
Growl warns you to back off.
Swallow prey, feast on it.

lines.zh: 用尾鞭打碎敌人的防御。
lines.en: Use tail to break defenses.
More fierce in bipedal form.
Collide, sending water flying.
Fights without backing down.
Shift to bipedal stance, ready to fight.

lines.zh: 用尖锐的牙齿撕裂对手。
lines.en: Sharp teeth tear at foes.
It uses its massive body to collide.
Bipodal leaps, closing the gap.
Wings augment the attack.
Show power in battle.
Bipedal stance, ready to strike.
Seeking a mate, time to breed.
Low growl to attract a mate.
Its eyes are filled with desire.
Wings gently touch.
Wrap around each other, ready to mate.
Whispers full of love.
Kiss to express emotion.

lines.zh: 交配后，它显得更加温柔。
lines.en: After mating, it seems gentler.
Use body language to communicate.
Hope for offspring shared.

lines.zh: 水草间滑动，鳞片摩擦声刺耳。
lines.en: Slithering through the water plants, scales scrape harshly.

lines.zh: 水面下翻身，激起一圈圈波纹。
lines.en: Flip beneath the surface, creating ripples.

lines.zh: 触须轻触，感觉猎物的位置。
lines.en: Whiskers touch, sensing prey's location.

lines.zh: 利爪插入泥中，稳固身体。
lines.en: Claws dig into the mud, stabilizing the body.
Eyes glow, locking onto the target.
Tail sways, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 皮肤鼓胀，充满战斗的渴望。
lines.en: Skin inflates, filled with combat eagerness.

lines.zh: 呼吸间喷出水雾，隐藏气息。
lines.en: Exhale to create mist, concealing scent.
Submerge and disappear.

lines.zh: 尾部轻轻摇摆，调整位置。
lines.en: Tail sways gently, adjusting position.
Beneath the surface, waiting for prey to approach.

lines.zh: 双眼紧盯着水面，寻找目标。
lines.en: Eyes fixed on the surface, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 听觉敏锐，捕捉细微声音。
lines.en: Sharp hearing, detecting faint sounds.

lines.zh: 鼻孔翕动，嗅出猎物的气味。
lines.en: Nostrils flaring, catching prey's scent.

lines.zh: 水面泛起涟漪，猎物现身。
lines.en: Ripples on the surface, prey appears.

lines.zh: 双翼微张，准备飞掠水面。
lines.en: Wings spread, preparing to swoop across the water.
Sharp beak closed, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 鳞片反射阳光，闪烁如宝石。
lines.en: Scales glint in the sunlight, like gemstones.

lines.zh: 潜行至猎物下方，准备捕食。
lines.en: Creeping beneath prey, ready to strike.
Eyes glow, locking onto the prey.
You crunched the gravel on the bank.
The splash gave you away.
This ford is mine.

lines.zh: 伏在浅水里，等你再走一步。
lines.en: I lie in the shallows, waiting one more step.
Prey in sight, target locked.

lines.zh: 鳍拍打水面，增加推进力。
lines.en: Fins slap the water, increasing thrust.

lines.zh: 利爪收紧，准备致命一击。
lines.en: Claws tighten, ready for the killing blow.
Tail swings, building up for the attack.
Underwater, accelerating towards prey.

lines.zh: 利齿露出口腔，准备撕咬。
lines.en: Sharp teeth show, ready to bite.

lines.zh: 水面泛起微波，加速攻击。
lines.en: Water ripples, accelerating the attack.

lines.zh: 双翼展开，准备飞跃水面。
lines.en: Wings spread, preparing to leap across the water.

lines.zh: 水下张开嘴，等它再走近一步。
lines.en: Jaws open underwater; one more step.
Body tenses, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 泥里的震动，我全感觉得到。
lines.en: I feel every tremor through the mud.
One step more and you're in reach.
I've slipped downstream of you.
Your shadow hits the water first.
I can hold my breath a long time.
Sssss, hold tight!
Bite through your skin!

lines.zh: 半身出水，这一口就结束。
lines.en: Half out of the water, this bite ends it.
Enjoy your last day!
Swallow you, food!
Hold on, try to move!
You won't last long!

lines.zh: 我从沼泽里立起来，用两条腿。
lines.en: I rear up out of the marsh on two legs.

lines.zh: 我从水里窜出来，咬住了。
lines.en: I burst from the water and clamp down.
It strikes straight up from below!
Its tail whips your knee.
This bite takes your boot.
I rear up and pin you.
You can't run fast in mud.
Out of the shadow of the marsh!
Threat beneath the water!
Danger by the shore!
From the depths of the marsh, the Varasuchus awakens!
Be wary of the threat by the shore!
Shadows beneath the water!
Ambush by the rocky shore!

lines.zh: 沼泽的阴影，蜷鳄龙来了！
lines.en: Marsh shadows, the Varasuchus is here!
Threat from the water surface appears!
Shadows by the shore!
The marsh surface bulges.
I roll over out of the silt.
One more shadow under the stone bank.
I claim this stretch of river.
Two eyes open in the reeds.
The waterbirds have all gone quiet.
Burned by flames, scales charred.
Fell into water, almost drowned.
Drowned, almost suffocated.

lines.zh: 爆炸冲击，我被震得喘不过气。
lines.en: Explosion shock, gasping for breath.
Hit by an arrow, yelp in pain.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击，我几乎被撕裂。
lines.en: Hit by magic, almost torn apart.
Starved, too weak to move.
Struck by lightning, searing pain.

lines.zh: 坠入虚空，我感觉寒冷刺骨。
lines.en: Fell into the void, icy cold.
